plugins.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: This app reads your activity, sleep, heart metrics, weight, hydration, and nutrition data from Apple Health to display your daily dashboard.
plugins.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Save the water amount you explicitly confirm, the body weight and measurement time you enter and explicitly confirm, and the meal calories, protein, carbohydrates, and fat from a photo that you explicitly confirm to Apple Health.
